title: Cube API Latency
dataSources: dbt Semantic Layer / MetricFlow query logs, Cube API request logs and pre-aggregation build metrics (`cube:api`), AtScale engine query logs, LookML validation and metric-definition change events.
app: dbt Semantic Layer / MetricFlow and Cube query logs and APIs via HEC scripted inputs; AtScale engine logs; LookML content-validator output.
spl:
index=bi sourcetype=cube:api event=query
| eval duration_ms=response_time_ms
| stats count as queries, p95(duration_ms) as p95_ms by endpoint
| eval p95_s=round(p95_ms/1000,2)
| where p95_s>3
| sort - p95_s
description: Measures Cube API response latency per endpoint and flags slow endpoints that degrade every embedded dashboard and application relying on the metrics API.
value: The metrics API sits on the hot path of many apps; per-endpoint latency shows where to add pre-aggregations or scale before users feel it.
implementation: Ingest Cube API logs; schedule daily; review slow endpoints; add rollups or cache. Correlate with pre-aggregation coverage.
visualization: Table by p95 latency, latency trend per endpoint.
grandmaExplanation: We time how quickly your shared metrics service answers, so slow spots get fixed before apps feel sluggish.
